description: Java abstract class ByteBuffer providing methods for reading and writing bytes, integers, and shorts with buffer management.

classes.name: ByteBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class providing buffer operations for byte data, including get, put, getInt, getShort, putInt, and buffer state checks.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is full.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Abstract method to get the buffer's capacity.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current data length in the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the next byte from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[], int, int)
methods.description: Reads bytes into an array starting at a specific offset.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Abstract method to put a byte into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[])
methods.description: Writes bytes from an array into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[], int, int)
methods.description: Writes bytes from an array into the buffer starting at a specific offset.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 16-bit short from the buffer.

methods.name: putInt
methods.description: Writes a little-endian 32-bit integer into the buffer.
